limitations: Lower-body only. Full body self, upper-body, cloth, dynamic balance and runtime import remain unaccepted.
Actual support patch clips real lowsole convex footprint to real scene triangles within 2 mm vertical tolerance; its convex hull is a support envelope, not a claim of uniform pressure.
Heel pivot tracks its declared real source heel vertex; whole-sole lock is not asserted during that interval.
Segment-mass COM is approximate. A negative static margin during walking is not alone proof of dynamic imbalance, and a positive margin is not a force-balance validation.
